# ServeGo - Local Services Marketplace Platform

ServeGo is a reliable, zero-commission local services marketplace connecting background-verified home service professionals (electricians, plumbers, carpenters, AC repair, cleaning) directly with customers in Aurangabad, Bihar, India.

## Key Links
- Main Website: https://servego.co.in
- Services Catalog: https://servego.co.in/#services
- Tracking Service Order: https://servego.co.in/track
- Partner Registration: https://servego.co.in/#become-worker
